articles.t: Where to pre-order GTA 6 as Rockstar announces soundtrack on vinyl
articles.chapeau: Rockstar Games has also announced it will be releasing the soundtrack on vinyl in December
articles.txt:

The wait for GTA 6 is almost over. After years of anticipation, several delays and lots and lots of fan speculation, Rockstar Games’ long-awaited sequel is almost upon us. In less than a month, we’ll all be heading back to Vice City.
With launch day fast approaching, Rockstar has just announced that the game’s original score, composed by Justice, will be released on vinyl and CD in December, with pre-orders now open. And if you haven’t yet pre-ordered the game itself, there’s still time to secure your copy ahead of time.
There are two editions of Grand Theft Auto 6 available to pre-order: the standard edition and the Ultimate Edition , with the latter only available digitally through the PlayStation Store and Xbox Store. If you’re wondering what comes with each edition or whether it's worth paying extra for the Ultimate Edition, here's everything you need to know before the game launches in November.
Grand Theft Auto 6 will officially launch on 19 November. If you pre-order a physical copy of the game, it’ll ship a week earlier than normal, but because it won’t come with a disc in the box (just a download code), you won’t get early access.
Rockstar Games says that physical copies will ship a week earlier so that people can pre-load the game ahead of time. The Standard Edition costs £69.99, while the Ultimate Edition costs £89.99. There are, however, already discounts to be found on the Standard Edition.
The Ultimate Edition of GTA 6 is available to pre-order digitally through the PlayStation Store and Xbox Store. It costs £89.99, which isn’t as much as many were fearing. What do you get with the Ultimate Edition that you don’t get with the Standard Edition? Rockstar has stuffed the Ultimate Edition with exclusive vehicles, weapons, clothing, missions and customisation options that unlock as you progress through Jason and Lucia's story.
In terms of vehicles, you’ll get a '67 Vapid Dominator Buggy, the returning '95 Grotti Cheetah sports car, a Dinka Enduro motorcycle, a Crest Kayak at Jason's safehouse and a Shitzu Squalo speedboat. You'll also receive exclusive mods for Jason's Vapid Ganado pickup, plus access to two exclusive vehicle workshops – Rideout Customs and One-Eyed Willie's.
For missions and activities, Rockstar is including a Classic Car Collection questline, which lets you restore abandoned vehicles, as well as the PTT Youngin$ compound raid activity, where you'll earn special contraband rewards as you play.
The Ultimate Edition also includes Hawk & Little Morgan Revolvers with Vice City styling, personalised versions of Jason's Girardi ES9 and Lucia's Klose K17 pistols, plus exclusive weapon customisation.
Finally, there are dozens of cosmetic extras. You can unlock exclusive Vice City-inspired outfits for Jason and Lucia, Goodtime Gear clothing and accessories, access to the Stock 305 streetwear shop, new hairstyles, facial hair, makeup and nail options from Sara's Unisex Salon, plus more than 50 exclusive tattoos from Electric Fang Tattoo.
By pre-ordering GTA 6 , you'll get a Vintage Vice City pack, which includes the '55 Vapid Stanier sedan, the Shore Court Garage near Ocean Beach, two Vice City-inspired outfits for Jason and Lucia, vintage hairstyles for both protagonists and a tropical weapon skin inspired by Tommy Vercetti's iconic palm-tree shirt.
On top of that, Rockstar is throwing in a free month of GTA +. The subscription includes a monthly GTA $500,000 deposit for GTA Online, bonus GTA $ when purchasing Shark Cards, access to exclusive discounts and member-only vehicles, plus a rotating library of Rockstar Games titles. The free month can be redeemed immediately after pre-ordering – just remember to cancel the subscription or you will be charged.
The Standard Edition of GTA 6 is available to pre-order from a number of UK retailers. It costs £69.99, but Argos and Amazon have already slashed £5 off the price.
Unlike the Ultimate Edition, the Standard Edition doesn't include any of the exclusive vehicles, missions, weapons or cosmetic extras. However, you'll still get the full GTA 6 single-player experience.
That said, you won't miss out on the pre-order bonuses. If you get the Standard Edition, you’ll receive the same Vintage Vice City pack as Ultimate Edition owners, complete with the classic '55 Vapid Stanier sedan, Shore Court Garage, retro outfits and hairstyles for Jaso

articles.chapeau: The big moment is here, but what happens if you haven't got a PS5?
articles.txt:
By Shaheer Khan Published Oct 30, 2026, 12:31 PM EDT Ever since a kid, Shaheer has always been intrigued by tech and how its components work, and has always geeked out over new PC component releases. His enthusiasm for tech, gaming, and composing eventually led him to become a writer, a career path he hadn’t quite planned or thought of, but it proved to be a natural fit. Nevertheless, Shaheer has been writing for more than 4 years, having penned more than 2000 articles now across multiple accredited publications. Shaheer mostly covers PC components, including in-depth coverage of each component, but his speciality subsumes within hardware of all sorts. Sign in to your MakeUseOf account After more than 13 years, or 4,811 days of waiting, Rockstar is finally releasing GTA 6. Following tradition with other recent Rockstar releases, GTA 6 will be console-exclusive at launch, with a PC port expected in 2027.
For those who want a taste of what Rockstar has been cooking for nearly a decade, a console is the only way in. GTA 6 is the biggest release in a decade , to the point that buying a console specifically for the game is a real consideration, but current prices will make anyone think twice before dropping that kind of money.
Fortunately, there’s a cheaper way to play GTA 6: buy a used PS5. However, buying a used console carries risks, so you’ll need to be very careful.
Dave Meikleham / MakeUseOf The 2023 PS5 with the disc drive. Credit: Suman Biswas/MUO Credit: Suman Biswas/MUO Credit: Suman Biswas/MUO Credit: Suman Biswas/MUO Close Dave Meikleham / MakeUseOf The 2023 PS5 with the disc drive. Credit: Suman Biswas/MUO Credit: Suman Biswas/MUO Credit: Suman Biswas/MUO Credit: Suman Biswas/MUO The PS5 originally launched with an MSRP of $500 for the disc version and $400 for the digital variant. Unfortunately, the memory shortage hasn't been kind to console users, and since launch, the console has had two official price hikes in the US, both in the latter half of its lifecycle, when a console's price usually drops.
PS5 Digital Edition saw the biggest price increase of the bunch, now 50% more expensive than at launch, and, unfortunately, it’s the most sought-after model.
PS5 on Ebay Credit: Shaheer Khan/MUO With such absurd prices and GTA 6 less than a month from release, getting a used PS5 seems like a feasible option. On eBay, used PS5 listings run about $350 for models in decent condition, which seems pretty viable — almost 50% less than the current MSRP.
Refurbished options cost a bit more, starting at $460 on the platform.
Pricing may vary across platforms like Facebook Marketplace, trade-in stores, and others. However, the savings are real, and as the holiday season approaches, many people will want a PS5 solely to play GTA 6 because no PS5 first-party games are releasing soon anyway.
PS5 laying Credit: MakeUseOf Used PS5 pricing looks alluring, but consider a few things before buying a second-hand console, especially as second-hand sellers know that the GTA 6 demand is looming large. Private sales don't guarantee a refund or exchange, so it's important to test out the console in person, and there's a list of checks you should perform before buying a used PS5:
When buying, ask the seller to remove their account from the PS5 and perform a factory reset so you can take a fresh console home. For extra safety, you can buy a refurbished model from a verified seller, but I don't recommend it, since it doesn't save as much money as a used PS5 normally would.
For reference, TechPowerUp reported that GameStop was selling a used PS5 Pro for $1,400 a few weeks earlier, 1.55X more than its MSRP . Scammers, scalpers, and worse are waiting for your cash; don't become a statistic.
GTA 6 Credit: Rockstar A good PS5 will run about $350–400 max, and maybe a few bucks more for the disc version. The disc version would be a pointless buy anyway, since GTA 6 is digital only and is 210GB, which would fit in every configuration, though you might need to kick out other games to make room.
In terms of cost savings, even after buying GTA 6 Ultimate Edition for $100, the total cost is less than a new Digital PS5.
Anyhow, PS5 is already in the final stages of its lifecycle, and the next-generation PS6 is rumored to be released next year, so buying a PS5 at its current retail price doesn't make sense.
Even if you're skeptical about spending that much on a used PS5, you can always recoup most of the money spent on the console when reselling it.

articles.t: What we know about GTA 6 animals so far
articles.chapeau: There will be over 170 different animal species in GTA 6, and this is what has been confirmed about them
articles.txt:
(Image credit: Rockstar) Jump To: GTA 6 animals list Rare, Discoverable, and Legendary animals Copy link Facebook X Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 0 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter GTA 6 animals are going to represent the broadest zoological spread ever seen in a Rockstar game, with a diverse selection of over 170 different species represented. This includes more than 60 types of bird, over 30 land mammals, plus a variety of reptiles, fish, and much more. Whether you find them in the wildernesses of GTA 6 or an enclosure in Leonida's own zoo there will be plenty to discover, so here's what we know so far about the animals in GTA 6. Visiting the zoo is one of many GTA 6 side activities available, but if you want a quiet trip then you'll need to lose your GTA 6 Wanted Level first.
Through a combination of trailers, screenshots, and previews there are already plenty of GTA 6 animals that we know about. These include:
The variety of creatures includes both expected wildlife for each area and invasive species, reflecting the diversity seen in real-life Florida. Each will have accurate movement animations following significant research, and are going to look more realistic than ever before thanks to additions such as iridescence, bioluminescence, translucency, and even different types of feathers. Coats and pelts have also been upgraded, with new hair and fur systems offering color variations, appearance changes when wet, and dirt matting picked up from the environment.
As seen during the Extended Look, you'll be presented with a choice of interactions when you approach GTA 6 animals and they'll respond accordingly. When Jason encounters a dog in the apartment complex, he has the option to Praise it from a distance then either Scold or Pet the dog when up close. Importantly, there is also an option to Study the animal, which will then add it to your compendium in a similar way to Red Dead Redemption 2, and there are likely to be rewards for filling in your logbook with the creatures you investigate.
In addition to the general GTA 6 animal species that you'll encounter around Leonida, Rockstar have confirmed that there will also be plenty of unusual creatures that you can track, in a similar way to the Red Dead Redemption series. These will be divided into Rare , Discoverable , and Legendary categories, but beyond that they are staying tight-lipped on details for now as they want players to make surprising discoveries for themselves while they explore.
Get ready to turn up the volume on all of the confirmed songs from the GTA 6 soundtrack , and imagine cruising around these GTA 6 locations .

articles.t: 18 years later, GTA 6 redeems Grand Theft Auto
articles.chapeau: Scooter brothers! We
articles.txt:
(Image credit: Rockstar Games) Copy link Facebook X Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 0 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter Rockstar is keeping a good thing going with GTA 6 . That being, the Scooter Brothers – a Grand Theft Auto meme that's slowly being a mainstay in the series.
Back when GTA 4 was released many a moon ago, one of the most viral videos from it featured a player who – while on a scooter – came across an NPC – on a scooter. Feeling a strong sense of kinship, the player shouts "scooter brothers!" and several other things. The video now has 7.5 million views on YouTube . The beauty of Scooter Brothers is in its simplicity and enthusiastic delivery.
Of course, Rockstar didn't leave things there. When swapping to Trevor in GTA 5 , there's a chance you'll find him – on a scooter – coming across an NPC – on a scooter. You see where we're going with this, yes?
So what's Rockstar got in store for GTA 6? Eagle-eyed fans thought something might be coming thanks to promotional material, but thankfully, Edge now has the definitive answer . An answer that pleasingly involves the Scooter Bros. moving up in the world.
If Jason or Lucia require their vehicle at any point in their Vice City romp, you can open your phone and the Scooter Bros. app will be waiting for you. Use it, and someone will be along shortly with your wheels before wheeling off themself into the sunset – on a scooter, naturally. It'll cost you a pretty penny, but we think the Scooter Brothers have earned your support at this point.
GTA 6 map size is so big it rivals GTA 4, GTA 5, and Red Dead Redemption 2's combined – and Rockstar devs are still discovering places they've never seen.

articles.t: Miami's E11EVEN Club Becomes GTA 6's NINE1NINE for One Night on November 6 | GTA BOOM
articles.chapeau: Tickets for E11EVEN's NINE1NINE Vice City night are on sale now, starting in the mid 40 dollar range, for 21 and over guests.
articles.txt:
In another example of real life imitating art after the art first imitated real life, the Miami nightclub that Grand Theft Auto VI parodied is about to become its own parody. E11EVEN Miami, the 24-hour downtown ultraclub, is transforming into NINE1NINE Vice City for one night on November 6, with Flo Rida performing, a party the club is throwing to celebrate the game.
The connection goes back to the first trailer . In December 2023, the debut Grand Theft Auto VI trailer showed an airplane-towed banner for a fictional Vice City nightclub called NINE1NINE, with the tagline Why Sixty Nine When You Can Nine 1 Nine. It was a clear nod to E11EVEN, an uber popular local spot that prides itself as the "the world's first and only 24/7 ultraclub" known for celebrity sets and the aerial banners it flies over South Beach.
E11EVEN did not let the shout-out pass. Days after the trailer, the club flew its own aerial banner reading When Nine 1 Nine = E11even. Its marketing director Eddie Franco said they embraced the reference for fun. The club has turned up in later trailer footage too . Now it is going all the way and becoming NINE1NINE for a night.
The November 6 event is billed as the IRL grand opening of NINE1NINE Vice City's Sexiest Nightclub, a one-night branding takeover of the real venue at 29 NE 11th Street with Flo Rida headlining. The tickets are out now through the club, with admission starting in the mid-40-dollar range and VIP tables available, under the usual 21-and-over and dress-code rules.
This is the club capitalizing on the joke, not an official Rockstar Games event. There is no Take-Two Interactive involvement. The event is purely E11EVEN's own promotion. It still fits the moment though, with Vice City drenched in Vice City branding as the launch of arguably the biggest Grand Theft Auto ever draws near.
This is the club's own promotion, timed to the game's launch window.
E11EVEN is the latest piece of a city that has gone full Vice City. Rockstar has hung a $975,000 Welcome to Vice City sign on the Kaseya Center , turned the Miami Heat into Vice City for a night , put beach gear and plane banners over South Beach , driven modded in-game cars through real streets and plastered crude in-universe ads on kiosks . Even the county signed a marketing deal after a public fight over it. A nightclub becoming its own fictional parody is the most Miami entry on that list, the one nobody needed to approve and something that we should've seen coming.
The club that inspired a fake GTA 6 nightclub is spending a night pretending to be it, with a hometown star on the mic.
If that doesn't prove just how much larger than life GTA 6 has become , we don't know what does.

articles.t: What Happens If You Cancel Your GTA 6 Preorder? - SVG
articles.chapeau: Sure, you can
articles.txt:
Rockstar Games Add SVG on Google: Preferred Source Google Discover It's no secret that "Grand Theft Auto 6" is one of the most preordered video games in history, if not the current apex. Rockstar Games has already reported that preorder sales have exceeded $600 million, and most of those sales are for the $100 Ultimate Edition of "GTA 6" instead of the $80 Standard Edition. However, if you're rethinking your purchase before the game is released on Nov. 19, you might be wondering what happens if you decide to cancel your preorder.
Whether it was a disappointing aspect of the Extended Showcase on Netflix or perhaps something in one of the recent trailers , you are fully entitled to cancel your "GTA 6" preorder. There are some stipulations and restrictions that come with getting a refund for your purchase, though, so you'll need to know about those before you can attempt to get your money back. Below, you can see if you qualify to cancel your preorder for "GTA 6" and what happens if you decide you want to back out.
Rockstar Games First and foremost, Rockstar Games has confirmed that players can cancel their "GTA 6" preorder and receive a full refund for the amount they've spent on their chosen edition. However, there are some caveats to canceling, and it also depends on whether you preordered a physical or digital edition of the game. It also matters whether you preordered from Rockstar Games or a major retailer, like Amazon, Best Buy, Walmart, etc.
Let's first cover how to cancel a digital preorder, as those are likely going to be more common than physical preorders, since physical editions don't actually contain a disc for "GTA 6." Luckily, the process works virtually the same regardless of what platform you're on. There are some differences depending on whether you're using PlayStation or Xbox.
On PlayStation, you can cancel your preorder and receive a full refund that's credited back to the payment method you used when purchasing "GTA 6." However, in order to receive your refund, you need to cancel before the download files for "GTA 6" are ready for pre-load. As of now, the pre-load date for "GTA 6" is set for Nov. 12, 2026, meaning you have until then to cancel your preorder. If you wait until the files are pre-loaded, this usually means your refund window has closed. You can contact PlayStation Support to see if a cancellation can still be done.
As for Xbox, your payment method typically won't be charged until roughly 10 days before a game's launch; in this case, on Nov. 9. If you cancel your preorder before Nov. 9, there's no refund, as you simply keep your money. Also, Xbox is more lenient than PlayStation when it comes to canceling preorders. As long as you haven't played "GTA 6" early, you can usually still cancel a preorder before an official release, and receive a full refund if you've been charged. You'll ideally want to cancel your preorder before the Nov 12. pre-load date, though, as refunds become less likely after "GTA 6" is installed on your console.
Rockstar Games If you've decided to buy a physical edition of "GTA 6," then you'll either have to revisit whatever retailer you preordered from or go through Rockstar directly . Every retailer works differently when it comes to canceling a preorder, so it's difficult to say what happens when you try to cancel through a storefront like Amazon or Walmart.
On the other hand, if you preordered from Rockstar, you can follow the steps outlined on Xsolla , which is the site where all physical preorders for "GTA 6" are handled. To quickly sum up, though, you can cancel a physical preorder prior to its shipping date. Rockstar has stated that physical editions should arrive around Nov. 12, which, again, is when the pre-load for the game will begin, so you'll need to cancel a preorder near the start of November to be sure you get your request in before the edition is shipped.
Finally, aside from getting a refund for "GTA 6," canceling a preorder for the game also means that you lose any added bonuses in "GTA Online." Specifically, preordering the game earns you a free month of the GTA+ membership, and if you haven't claimed that bonus, then it will become unavailable after you cancel your preorder.

articles.t: GTA 6 : le système de moralité inspiré de Red Dead Redemption 2 évolue, votre profil criminel influencera l'histoire
articles.txt:
Rockstar Games continue de dévoiler les coulisses de Grand Theft Auto 6 , et la dernière information en date concerne un système de moralité profondément remanié, directement inspiré de celui de Red Dead Redemption 2 . Rob Nelson, co-directeur du studio Rockstar North et responsable du développement, a détaillé le fonctionnement du « Profil Criminel » dans une interview accordée au magazine Edge. Ce système permettra aux joueurs de définir quel type de criminel ils incarnent, avec des conséquences tangibles sur le monde et le scénario.
Le cœur de cette nouveauté réside dans une échelle de moralité dynamique qui suivra les actions des deux protagonistes, Lucia et Jason . Cette échelle s’étendra de « Professionnel » à « Irrécupérable », symbolisée par des icônes d’ange et de démon. L’idée n’est pas de forcer les joueurs à devenir des saints, mais de les rendre conscients de la violence qu’ils déploient. Comme l’explique Nelson, « il n’y a pas de bonne ou de mauvaise façon de jouer à ce jeu, mais des actions cohérentes peuvent avoir un impact sur la façon dont le monde réagit à vous et sur la façon dont le récit se déroule ».
Concrètement, cela signifie que chaque décision, qu’il s’agisse de la manière de gérer un affrontement ou de simples interactions avec l’environnement, influencera ce profil. Un criminel « Professionnel » pourra par exemple neutraliser un adversaire sans le tuer, privilégier l’intimidation ou la corruption pour obtenir ce qu’il veut, tandis qu’un profil « Irrécupérable » résultera d’une approche plus brutale et expéditive. Le jeu ne punit pas la violence en soi, mais récompense la retenue et la réflexion.
L’impact de ce système ne se limitera pas à une simple jauge cosmétique. Rockstar a confirmé que le Profil Criminel affectera directement le déroulement de l’histoire. Les joueurs qui visent une fin spécifique devront donc surveiller attentivement leurs actions. Cette approche rappelle le système d’honneur de Red Dead Redemption 2 , mais poussé plus loin, avec une granularité plus fine et des répercussions plus immédiates sur le monde ouvert.
Nelson a également souligné que de petits actes de gentillesse peuvent racheter un profil en chute libre. Ramasser des déchets, nourrir les oiseaux dans un parc : ces micro-interactions, apparemment anodines, contribueront à redorer votre image. Cela crée une boucle de gameplay intéressante où chaque choix compte, même en dehors des missions principales.
Lors d’une précédente interview avec IGN, Nelson avait déjà expliqué la philosophie derrière ce système. L’objectif était d’éviter que les personnages joueurs ne deviennent trop puissants, en introduisant une forme de responsabilité. « Il n’y a pas de bonne ou de mauvaise façon de jouer à ce jeu, mais des actions cohérentes peuvent avoir un impact », répète-t-il. Cette déclaration souligne la volonté de Rockstar de créer une expérience plus immersive et réactive, où le monde se souvient de vos actes.
Cette approche s’inscrit dans la lignée des évolutions narratives de Rockstar, qui cherche à rendre ses mondes ouverts plus vivants et crédibles. GTA 6 promet ainsi une profondeur inédite pour la série, où la moralité n’est pas qu’un simple gadget, mais un véritable pilier du gameplay et de la narration.
Pour rappel, Grand Theft Auto 6 a été officiellement annoncé en décembre 2023 avec un premier trailer qui a battu des records. Le jeu se déroulera dans l’État de Leonida, une version fictive de la Floride, avec pour ville principale Vice City. Les deux protagonistes, Lucia et Jason, formeront un duo inspiré de Bonnie et Clyde. La sortie est prévue pour l’automne 2025 sur PlayStation 5 et Xbox Series X/S , avec une version PC attendue ultérieurement.
Les informations sur le système de moralité s’ajoutent à une liste déjà longue de fonctionnalités prometteuses : un monde ouvert plus dense, des interactions plus poussées avec les PNJ, et une physique améliorée. Rockstar semble vouloir repousser les limites de l’immersion, et ce nouveau système de profil criminel en est une preuve supplémentaire.
En attendant de pouvoir mettre la main sur le jeu, les fans peuvent spéculer sur les implications de ce système. Sera-t-il possible de terminer l’histoire en tant que criminel « Professionnel » ? Les fins multiples seront-elles nombreuses ? Autant de questions qui trouveront leurs réponses à la sortie du jeu.

articles.chapeau: Après deux décennies à matraquer X ou A pour fuir la police, GTA 6 change la donne. Ce nouveau sprint sur L3 pourrait-il vraiment tout améliorer ?
articles.txt:
Après deux décennies à matraquer X ou A pour fuir la police, GTA 6 change la donne. Ce nouveau sprint sur L3 pourrait-il vraiment tout améliorer ?
Depuis plus de 20 ans, les joueurs de GTA appuient frénétiquement sur X sur PlayStation ou A sur Xbox pour s’enfuir d’une fusillade ou semer la police. Avec GTA 6 , cette habitude vieille d’environ 25 ans prend fin : le sprint ne se fera plus en matraquant un bouton, mais via le stick gauche.
Rockstar Games a confirmé que le jeu revoit en profondeur les déplacements dans la nouvelle Vice City, et l’un des changements les plus visibles concerne justement la course. Reste une vraie question pour la communauté : ce changement de bouton de sprint dans GTA 6 , présenté comme une amélioration de confort, va-t-il vraiment rendre le jeu plus agréable ou briser des réflexes ancrés depuis GTA III en 2001 ?
Dans les précédents épisodes, de GTA III à GTA 5 , la formule était la même : le stick analogique pour marcher ou trottiner, et le sprint activé en tapotant rapidement X sur PlayStation ou A sur Xbox. Ce « tap-to-sprint Rockstar » était devenu la norme, au point d’être associé à l’identité de la série.
Comme le détaille GameRant, GTA 6 élimine la nécessité de marteler un bouton pour courir. Désormais, le sprint sera déclenché en cliquant sur le stick gauche, le fameux L3 sur PS5 (ou son équivalent sur Xbox Series X|S ). Un simple clic, et Jason ou Lucia partent à pleine vitesse, sans spam frénétique sur la façade de la manette.
Ce choix aligne enfin Grand Theft Auto VI sur la plupart des jeux d’action modernes en vue troisième personne, où le clic sur L3 est devenu la norme. Rockstar avait déjà proposé des schémas alternatifs dans GTA 5 ou Red Dead Redemption 2 , mais jamais comme configuration par défaut. Avec GTA 6 sprint L3 , le studio semble prêt à tourner la page.
Premier effet évident de la fin du « tapoter X pour courir » : moins de fatigue et de crispation dans le pouce droit. Sur des sessions longues ou des poursuites répétées, ce matraquage pouvait vite devenir épuisant, voire douloureux pour certains joueurs. En déplaçant l’action sur L3, Rockstar améliore clairement le confort et l’accessibilité.
Autre gain clé, la caméra. Ne plus avoir à alterner entre le stick droit et le bouton X/A permet de garder en permanence le contrôle du cadre, crucial dans les fusillades, les courses poursuites ou les ruelles serrées de Leonida. Ce changement de bouton de sprint GTA 6 devrait rendre les déplacements plus fluides et lisibles.
Reste la notion de « friction » voulue. Rockstar rappelle que le réalisme ne doit pas se faire au détriment du plaisir, et simplifie certaines mécaniques pour éviter la frustration. Le sprint L3 va dans ce sens, même si une partie de la communauté regrette déjà la sensation physique de marteler X, jugée plus immersive. D’autres s’inquiètent de l’usure du stick et du fameux stick drift.
Point important, Rockstar n’a pas encore publié le schéma complet des commandes GTA 6 sur PS5 et Xbox . GameRant confirme la disparition du matraquage obligatoire, mais il reste possible que la commande classique X/A sprint soit conservée en option, comme dans les précédents jeux du studio. Les menus d’accessibilité et la personnalisation des touches devraient jouer un rôle clé.
Ce changement intervient alors que GTA 6 est attendu le 19 novembre 2026 sur PS5 et Xbox Series X|S . Il symbolise un virage assumé vers plus de confort manette, dans un open world encore plus vaste . Reste à voir, manette en main, si les joueurs adopteront ce nouveau réflexe ou s’ils chercheront immédiatement comment réactiver le sprint sur X et A dans les options.

Well thanks to the souped-up morality system there will be a bit of space for some redemption.
Rob Nelson, Rockstar North's co-studio head and head of development went into greater detail about what GTA 6 's "Criminal Profile" involves during an interview for Edge magazine and how players will have some authority about how the world will react to them.
The Criminal Profile will track your actions as Lucia and Jason on a scale from "Professional" to "Irredeemable", represented by angel and devil icons. It's not necessarily encouraging you all to be saints who disengage with any form of violence and follow road traffic laws to a tee, but you have to be mindful of how much violence you doll out.
Fights don't need to always end in death, a professional criminal may incapacitate their opponent instead of putting a bullet between their eyes or perhaps try to get information or whatever they want from them via less violent means, at least at first. You may try to intimidate or perhaps bribe your way to the best ending. Rockstar has confirmed that your Criminal Profile will affect how the story pans out and so it's certainly something to keep an eye on, if you're gunning for a specific storyline that is.
We've already learned a bit about the Criminal Profile before thanks to an IGN preview in which Nelson also explained how the decision to include such a responsive system stemmed from the fact that the devs didn't want player characters to become too powerful.
"There isn't a right or wrong way to play this game, but consistent actions may have an impact in terms of how the world reacts to you and how the narrative plays out," Nelson says. He also explained how small acts of kindness can redeem you. So, if you see some litter lying around, put it in the bin and if you have a free moment perhaps go to the local park and feed the birds.

articles.chapeau: Apparently they turn up on time and everything.
articles.txt:
(Image credit: Rockstar Games) Copy link Facebook X Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 0 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter Yes, Grand Theft Auto is a videogame series where you drive fast cars and occasionally mow down the odd pedestrian here and there. I like that. It's nice. I am looking forward to also doing that in Grand Theft Auto 6 . But the thing I'm really excited to do? Hop on a bus, baby.
Out of all 16(!!) pages from Edge magazine's newest megafeature on Rockstar's upcoming meteor, a teeny-tiny paragraph about Leonida's public transportation system is the one that's got me feeling all giddy. Similarly to Red Dead Redemption 2, the game will feature a fully functioning train system, as well as a bunch of bus routes to help you get around Leonida the old-fashioned way.
And, according to head of development Phil Hooker, they're systems that he has extensively tested to ensure their reliability. "I'm obsessed with making sure they always turn up," he told Edge. "So, anywhere in the middle of playing, I'll just go: right, we're going to get the bus to where we're going. I've memorised all of the routes."
I kind of love it, I can't lie. It really feels like Rockstar is paring down the criminal power fantasy a tiny bit and offering more grounded, realistic ways to exist in its world. Which might make some hardcore pedestrian-mowers a little furrow-browed, but it seems as though the developer is trying to create various levels at which people can engage with the chaos and zaniness the series has typically offered.
As much as I'm also a member of the crime spree brigade, something like a public transportation system is one of those details that's going to make Leonida feel alive in a way we've not really seen from the series before. It feels fitting for a story like Jason and Lucia's, too—it seems like they don't quite want the all-out criminal fame of previous protagonists, and allowing them to engage with more practical methods of getting around feels like the perfect way to play into that.
It's not just a cutesy way to roleplay an everyday commuter, either. Hooker also highlights making use of the buses and trains as a way to evade the watchful gaze of the police. "If they don't see you get on, and then you get out of the 'wanted' area, why would they search the bus unless they see you get onto it?"
More than anything, Edge's feature now has me desperate to go buy a beer, a pack of smokes, and jump onto a bus to watch the world go by. Though the only place I think Hooker is wrong is that he's been rigorously ensuring everything turns up on time—I dunno how things work in Florida, but the true realistic experience would be to have no buses turn up for ages until two or three arrive bumper-to-bumper. That's the true public transportation experience, after all.

articles.t: Cliff Richard GTA 6: 1976 Hit, No Idea What It Is [2026]
articles.chapeau: Cliff Richard GTA 6: his 1976 song Devil Woman is in the extended look, yet he told The Times he is unsure what the game is. Facts checked.
articles.txt:
Elias Virtanen October 30, 2026 11 min read Cliff Richard has no idea what Grand Theft Auto VI is, even though his 1976 song “Devil Woman” appeared in the game’s extended look. Dexerto reported the story this week, and it spread quickly because the gap is so wide. One of Britain’s best-known pop veterans sits inside the marketing for one of the most watched game launches of the year, and he cannot say what the game is.
The Cliff Richard GTA 6 story works as a funny headline, but it also says something useful about how Rockstar Games sells a blockbuster. Music is a marketing channel, and catalog songs reach audiences that no trailer voiceover can. This analysis lays out what is confirmed, what is not, and what the episode means for artists, labels and the studio.
We have followed the run-up to launch closely, from the unconfirmed soundtrack leak to the questions around review copies. This piece adds the music angle, with one rule: every figure and quote below traces back to a named outlet, and anything unverified is labeled as such.

The core of the story is an interview with The Times. According to Dexerto’s account of that conversation, Richard learned about the placement secondhand. When asked about it, he said, “I was told this happened!” GameSpot also carried that line in its own write-up, which framed the singer as an artist with music in the game who knew nothing about any of it.
The family angle gave the story its warmth. Richard said, “My nephew, who has two boys, said they came screaming to him, ‘Dad, it’s Uncle Cliff!’” The image is easy to picture. Two young players hear a 1976 pop single inside a game trailer and recognize the voice of a relative.
He added his own read on what that reaction meant. NME’s coverage quotes him saying, “They didn’t realise I could sing like that.” The comment is gentle and self-aware. It also shows that the placement landed as a surprise for the audience and the artist alike.
The line that carried the most headlines came when Richard tried to place the project. He asked, “The show is a game show, isn’t it, really? One of the biggest on TV?” GamesRadar used that sentence in its headline , and it is easy to see why. It compresses the whole story into one question.
Read charitably, the quote shows a man guessing at a medium he does not follow. Read cynically, it shows how far the Grand Theft Auto name has traveled beyond gaming. Either way, the remark is not a scandal. Nothing in the reporting suggests Richard objected to the placement or felt misled. The tone across the coverage is amused, and Richard himself comes across as good-natured about it.
That tone matters for how readers should treat the story. This is a curiosity about reach, not a dispute about rights. Anyone expecting a licensing fight will not find one in the sources we reviewed.
“Devil Woman” came out in 1976, which puts it roughly half a century before the game’s marketing cycle. Per the reporting cited above, the song appeared in an official extended look at Grand Theft Auto VI. The Independent framed the moment as an unlikely renaissance for the singer , tying the placement to the game’s soundtrack.
Rockstar Games is the company behind both the game and its music selection, according to the cited coverage. The studio has not, in the material we reviewed, published an explanation of why this particular song was chosen. That silence is normal. Rockstar rarely walks through its creative choices ahead of release, and it usually lets the work speak first.
The pairing still makes sense on its face. A 1970s single with a theatrical hook suits a trailer that wants an instant mood. Catalog tracks bring built-in texture, and viewers who never heard the original still feel the era. The placement says more about editorial taste than about any attempt to chase Richard’s fan base.

articles.t: GTA 6 Mod Restrictions: Rockstar
articles.chapeau: Hoping to mod "Grand Theft Auto VI" when it comes out? Hold on, Rockstar has a few rules you
articles.txt:
Rockstar Games Add SVG on Google: Preferred Source Google Discover Modding has become a core part of the video game community, with millions of mods being developed for all genres of games, from the epic fantasies of "Elder Scrolls" to indie cozies like "House Flipper." It's not something that's left the "Grand Theft Auto" franchise behind, either, as plenty of mods exist for the previous title, "Grand Theft Auto 5." But if you were looking forward to continuing your modding experience in "Grand Theft Auto 6," you might want to make other plans. Rockstar Games has released a revised set of rules that restricts a wide variety of mods in "GTA 6."
These rules dictate what aspects of the game players are allowed and not allowed to mod, and they are much different than what was enforced in previous games. In the single-player mode of "GTA 5," for example, players were able to mod just about anything , aside from story content. While that restriction remains in place in "GTA 6," Rockstar has imposed a number of other regulations on the modding community.
Rockstar Games The new modding guidelines apply to all IPs under the Rockstar Games umbrella, so this includes "GTA 6," "GTA 5," "Red Dead Redemption 2," and other titles. While Rockstar still allows modding in a broad sense, there are now strict restrictions on what players can add and change to the company's library of games.
For starters, Rockstar has kept the rule about not modding story content, characters, individual missions, etc. This has been one of the main restrictions on mods from the beginning, so it's not a surprise to see that one still in place. The other primary rule Rockstar has always held is that players aren't allowed to mod any online multiplayer element of its games. Only modders recognized by the Rockstar Creator Platform are allowed to mod multiplayer modes, such as "GTA Online."
In addition to the existing restrictions, there are several other new rules. Players are not allowed to mix and match different Rockstar IPs with each other in mods. So you can't bring Arthur Morgan (much less his modded Joker version) from "Red Dead Redemption 2" into "GTA 6," for example. You also can't take elements of the maps in one Rockstar game and add them into a different title — no jaunts to San Andreas, unless Rockstar themselves puts the trip in.
The guidelines finish up by stating that modders aren't allowed to monetize their creations unless they're permitted by Rockstar, and modders can't infringe upon any third-party IP with mods. Overall, modders need to follow the Rockstar terms of service and community guidelines when creating mods. It's a lot to keep track of.
Rockstar Games With "GTA 6" releasing in a matter of weeks, some players might be wondering if mods will be available right from the start. Unfortunately, that won't be the case, as Rockstar has — yes — additional rules for mods on the PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S.
According to the new guidelines, mods are prohibited from being developed for consoles. This means you won't be able to download any mods for the PS5 or Xbox at the launch of "GTA 6." And as console mods need to be officially supported by the developer to work, there's no sneaking them in, either.
So with this restriction in place, players will have to wait until the PC release of "GTA 6" before any mods can be created or used. At this time, it looks like the PC version of "GTA 6" will be released sometime in the first half of 2027, but Rockstar has not yet confirmed an official timeframe. When the PC version does hit the virtual shelves, the modding will likely begin immediately, giving players an entirely new well of content to dip into — provided they stay within the rules, of course.

Rockstar Games continue de dévoiler de nouvelles informations et mécaniques de gameplay à l’approche de la sortie de son jeu.
GTA 6 arrive dans 20 petits jours , c’est désormais officiel. Le jeu est GOLD , il a achevé sa production, il ne pourra donc plus être reporté et Rockstar vient de confirmer l’information au cours d’une nouvelle preview avec le magazine Edge. Le studio confirme que, désormais, il considère GTA 6 comme étant « prêt pour le lancement » et que l’avenir ne leur appartient plus.
Nous avons appris également que Sam Houser, le président de Rockstar Games, l’un des hommes les plus influents de l’industrie du jeu vidéo , malgré sa grande discrétion, a bien joué un rôle majeur dans la production de ce Grand Theft Auto VI . Aux côtés d’Aaron Garbut ou encore de Rob Nelson, les responsables du développement, il a apporté de nombreuses solutions , pris des décisions primordiales pour identifier les problèmes ou les questions qu’il fallait résoudre ensuite avec et à travers les équipes.
Sam Houser a d’ailleurs sélectionné minutieusement l’intégralité des musiques qui seront présentes dans les 23 stations de radio du jeu, comme à son habitude. Il a également contribué à façonner l’orientation de GTA 6 , la disposition de la carte, le développement des personnages, des éléments de l’histoire et a pris des décisions créatives majeures.
Après plus de dix ans de production, le jeu est prêt à arriver sur PS5 et Xbox Series X/S le 19 novembre prochain et nous avons eu le droit à de nouveaux détails avec encore des précisions qui confirment que le jeu sera ultraimmersif avec l’objectif de proposer une interactivité jamais vue dans l’histoire du gaming.
L’histoire de GTA 6 , avec la relation de Jason et Lucia sera un élément central du jeu . Plutôt que de faire du crime l’unique moteur du récit, l’intention est de placer au centre le lien qui unit les deux personnages, avec tout ce qu’il implique en termes de confiance, de dépendance et de tensions. Une approche inédite pour la licence.
Rockstar nous promet une histoire où l’intime et le criminel sont liés . Avec Jason et Lucia, un ancrage émotionnel plus fort pourrait être donné à GTA 6 , sans renoncer à la satire et à l’excès qui définissent la série.
Car oui, si Jason et Lucia évoluent dans un univers où les activités criminelles les exposent en permanence au danger, leur relation apporte une dimension plus personnelle à l’ensemble. Un attachement réel aux deux personnages est recherché. Le crime reste au cœur de l’aventure, mais devient aussi le terrain sur lequel leur relation se construit ou se fragilise. Il s’agit de l’opus le plus narratif proposé à ce jour par Rockstar.
Ce choix pourrait également apporter une tonalité particulière à l’aventure. Là où les précédents épisodes reposaient sur des personnages dont les intérêts entraient parfois en collision, la relation entre Jason et Lucia semble constituer le fil conducteur de l’histoire . Comme avec Red Dead Redemption II , Rockstar cherche vraiment à toucher et impacter les joueurs avec un jeu plus fort et plus centré sur les émotions.
On le sait, le gameplay n’a jamais été le fort de Rockstar Games. Du moins, on pouvait souvent reprocher aux jeux d’être assez classiques avec un gameplay lent et des personnages lourds. Pour GTA 6 , Rockstar semble avoir beaucoup travaillé sur cela. Ils l’ont souligné de nombreuses fois dans pas mal d’interviews et les précédentes previews.
Avec GTA 6 , Rockstar cherche à offrir quelque chose de diffrent , où les mécaniques de gameplay ne fonctionnent pas de manière isolée . articles.t: The Onion Is Ready For GTA 6: ‘You're Kind of a Dummy For Thinking This Is Gonna Change Everything"
articles.chapeau: Who satirizes the satire?
articles.txt:
We’re less than one month away from the release of Grand Theft Auto 6 , and the world is preparing for what’s bound to be a culturally dominant moment. Sick days are being planned, economists are doom-spiraling, and people are debating whether it’s possible to digitally cheat on your significant other with Lucia. It’s safe to say that it’s going to be a circus, and everyone wants a bit of that pie. That includes The Onion.
The satirical publication has already started to take aim at Rockstar’s open-world crime game over the past few months, with headlines like “Hyperrealistic ‘GTA VI’ Feature Makes Players Serve Out Prison Sentences In Real Time ” and “ Rockstar Announces ‘GTA VI’ Soundtrack Contains 10,000 Songs By Randy Newman .” The kings of online comedy are as ready for the moment as anyone.
But what’s so funny about GTA 6 anyways? In an interview with Polygon about The Onion’s first-ever video game, The Onion Voting Simulator 3D , head writer Mike Gillis explained why he finds GTA 6 — and the "seismic impact” it’s bound to have come November — especially ripe for comedy.
A man and woman are in a car. The woman leans to look out the window, and the man drives while holding a drink. There's a city skyline behind them. Rockstar Games “The world of quadruple or quintuple-A games is so funny,” Gillis said. “I think just like any time something becomes a center of gravity like that, to deflate it and play with people's expectations and kind of feel like you're kind of a dummy for thinking this is gonna change everything, that’s great! … It's a game! I can't think of any cultural product ever that's changed everything forever. It'll make a big impact and then it will evaporate!”
While The Onion looks forward to raining on everyone’s parade, Gillis said that he’s still very much excited for GTA 6 from an enthusiast side. That balance is part of what fuels The Onion’s wider approach to satirizing the world of video games, which the site has done for decades. (In 2019, it even launched its own parody of IGN, fittingly called OGN.) For Gillis, writing satire about video games is about resisting the “very passé way of engaging with games as if it's an embarrassing hobby” and embracing how expansive the umbrella is.
A weekly cheat sheet to what you’ll eventually love to play. No buying, no commitment — just saving for later.
“Some of it's just a toy, some of it is propaganda, some of it is produced by massive corporations that are trying to wring money out of you in addictive ways,” Gillis said. “It's a really wide expanse. But then, it's just like one of the most unvarnished joys. There's this intrinsic love of just playing games. It's so, so great. And so to come at it also from the perspective of an enthusiast, somebody who loves the medium, I think that also comes across when that's how you're talking about it instead of ‘I'm skeptical of it! Why would anybody ever play a game? Who are these fools in the beautiful artistic landscape of possibility!?’”
Considering that GTA 6 is poised to be an enormous game , The Onion should have plenty to poke fun at soon enough. Though it will also have a difficult task ahead of it, considering that GTA itself is known for lampooning every aspect of the modern world, including the video game industry. Can The Onion successfully outsatirize satire? We’ll find out come Nov. 19 — well, when we’re not too busy playing GTA 6 , that is.

articles.t: GTA 6’s Attention To Detail Is Getting A Little Ridiculous
GTA 6 : sulfureuse, provocatrice, violente… comment Rockstar Games a cultivé la polémique pour en faire une marque de fabrique de la saga
articles.chapeau: Que ce soit dans les jeux « Grand Theft Auto » ou dans la manière dont Rockstar Games conçoit ses œuvres et les fait exister médiatiquement,
articles.txt:
Que ce soit dans les jeux « Grand Theft Auto » ou dans la manière dont Rockstar Games conçoit ses œuvres et les fait exister médiatiquement, la provocation et la satire sont utilisées depuis les débuts de la saga pour conquérir le trône du jeu vidéo.
« Violent », « provocateur », « vulgaire »… Voici des qualificatifs qui ont de grandes chances de surgir si les jeux de la saga « Grand Theft Auto » sont mentionnés dans une conversation. Et c’est tout à fait normal puisque cet aspect sulfureux est à la fois constitutif de l’univers des jeux « GTA » , et de l’entreprise qui les développe, Rockstar Games.
À l’époque du premier opus, ce n’est pas Rockstar Games qui est aux commandes, mais le studio DMA Design. Avec l’entreprise qui distribue le jeu, BMG Interactive, ils décident d’engager un publiciste britannique controversé, Max Clifford, pour promouvoir le premier « Grand Theft Auto ».
Le publiciste suit alors la stratégie de démolir volontairement l’image du jeu, en divulguant des informations aux tabloïds anglais, capables de piétiner un jeu vidéo pour en faire un phénomène médiatique.
« Et ça a fonctionné. GTA est tout de suite devenu un produit sulfureux », explique Olivier Mauco, directeur de l’Observatoire européen des jeux vidéo qui analyse la saga depuis de nombreuses années.
Mais le caractère sulfureux de la licence apparaît plus fortement à la sortie de « GTA 4 » en 2008, considéré comme le premier « GTA » à apporter une puissante identité narrative. « Il y a toute une tirade sur l’exploitation des migrants, sur la privation de liberté », se remémore Olivier Mauco.
Par exemple, en parlant de liberté, « GTA 4 » se déroule dans la ville fictive de Liberty City, clairement inspirée de New York. On y trouve notamment une statue gris-vert représentant une femme drapée d’une robe, une couronne sur la tête. Elle a le bras levé, un gobelet de café dans la main. Son nom, c’est la « Statue de l’Hilarité », une allusion à peine voilée à la statue américaine la plus célèbre. À l’intérieur, s’il est curieux (car rien dans le jeu ne l’y amène), le joueur peut trouver un cœur gigantesque, enserré dans des chaînes et battant faiblement. Le cœur de cette fausse statue de la liberté, à Liberty City, n’est lui-même pas libre.
Avec ce message de privation de liberté, le nom de la statue, « « Hilarité » et son visage, on reconnaît bien là les traits d’Hillary Clinton. Un clin d’oeil qui prend tout son sens à la lumière d’un précédent scandale qui avait ébranlé Rockstar Games au moment de la sortie du jeu « GTA : San Andreas ». Hillary Clinton, alors sénatrice de New York, avait réclamé une enquête auprès de la Federal Trade Commission, accusant le studio d’avoir trompé les consommateurs sur la classification d’âge du jeu en y dissimulant du contenu sexuel.
Dans cet opus, un mini-jeu sexuel, prévu par les développeurs mais abandonné par la suite, y était resté caché. Mais un « moddeur » ( une personne utilisant les fichiers d’un jeu pour y apporter des modifications ) était parvenu à rétablir le mini-jeu en question et à le rendre accessible à tous.
Conséquence : Rockstar Games a dû retirer « GTA : San Andreas » des rayons et stopper provisoirement sa production. Dans une interview donnée à Virgin Radio au Royaume-Uni, Dan Houser, auteur et réalisateur du jeu, raconte qu’ils ont « reçu des amendes énormes ». Il décrit ensuite une situation « très perturbante pour l’entreprise » pendant laquelle « certaines personnes ont démissionné ».

Alors que GTA 6 approche de sa sortie, Rockstar Games vient de laisser entrevoir l’ampleur de son prochain blockbuster. Le magazine britannique Edge a eu l’occasion d’assister à une présentation de 90 minutes de gameplay non scénarisé dans les locaux de Rockstar North, à Edimbourg.
Aux commandes, à nouveau Rob Nelson, l’un des responsables de Rockstar Games, qui a dévoilé plusieurs mécaniques inédites, allant de la gestion du carburant à la relation entre Jason et Lucia, en passant par des interactions particulièrement poussées avec des PNJ.

Contrairement à certains épisodes précédents, les joueurs pourront rapidement prendre la route vers le nord et découvrir de nouvelles régions sans nécessairement progresser dans les missions principales.
Rockstar souhaite ainsi encourager une exploration plus naturelle , où la curiosité est récompensée.
Aaron Garbut, codirecteur du studio, explique d’ailleurs qu’après plusieurs années passées à parcourir des versions toujours plus détaillées du jeu, il lui arrive encore de découvrir des endroits qu’il n’avait jamais vus auparavant.
C’est probablement l’une des anecdotes les plus étonnantes de cette présentation. Rockstar avait initialement développé une animation permettant à un personnage de réagir à une odeur désagréable dans une situation précise.
Mais les développeurs ont finalement décidé d’étendre ce système à d’autres environnements.
Durant la démonstration, Jason entre dans une maison salie par un chien, grimace et recule instinctivement.
«GTA VI» va avoir droit à une soirée de lancement à Genève Le plus impressionnant? Selon les informations rapportées par Edge , cette réaction ne proviendrait pas d’une cinématique spécifiquement écrite pour cette situation. Il s’agirait d’une interaction déclenchée par les caractéristiques de l’environnement.
Un détail qui pourrait sembler anodin, mais qui illustre parfaitement l’attention portée par Rockstar aux réactions des personnages.
Autre changement majeur: le cycle jour-nuit de GTA 6 sera nettement plus long que celui de GTA 5 . Les couchers de soleil dureront davantage, tandis que les nuits offriront plus de temps pour profiter des activités nocturnes de Vice City.
La météo bénéficiera également d’un système particulièrement sophistiqué.

La relation entre les deux protagonistes devrait occuper une place centrale dans GTA 6. Selon Rob Nelson, Jason et Lucia commencent leur aventure avec une envie commune: être ensemble et donner une nouvelle chance à leur relation. Mais leur histoire ne serait pas totalement figée.

GTA 6 and 14 Other Big Games Launching in November 2026
articles.chapeau: Rockstar's biggest open-world game is finally launching, but there's plenty else to experience, including a remake of a beloved classic.
articles.txt:
T he time has finally come. November, as usual, offers a pretty packed slate of releases. Sequels, remakes, expansions, indie games, a weird new Sonic collaboration – so it goes. Honestly, even if you weren’t keen on visiting Vice City, there’s enough to keep you busy.
But it’s also the month when you-know-what finally launches, and the excitement is palpable. So as we go over the 15 biggest new games launching in November 2026, let’s start with the biggest of all…
After years of rumors, anticipation and delays, Grand Theft Auto 6 finally launches on November 19th for Xbox Series X/S and PC. A map that’s triple the playable area of Red Dead Redemption 2 , an 80-hour story with twists and turns, attention to detail that you have to see to believe – it’s simply unlike anything else that the industry may offer for the longest time. And it feels damn good to get to play it.
The other big release and one that’s still very much anticipated in its own right is The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake, out on November 5th for Switch 2. Graphical overhaul aside, there’s quite a few quality of life improvements, including swapping items with a button rather than going into your menu, a jump button, gyro controls for aiming and even Threads of Time for tracking progress. If nothing else, the fact that Kaepora Gaebora no longer traps you in an endless unsuspecting conversational loop is a win.
Out on November 3rd and described as the “darkest and most disturbing” DLC for the looter shooter, Echoes of Central Park finally opens Upper West Side and Central Park in an intriguing flashback narrative. You’ll unlock new gear, including the Ratel exotic; experiment with new skill variants; and have a new endgame activity that involves escaping hunters in Central Park while acquiring better gear to fight back. Touted as twice as large as Battle for Brooklyn , it could be a worthwhile addition to The Division 2 , especially since it’s still receiving new content (unlike a certain other looter shooter).
What’s better than the psychological torment that only coordinating puzzle-platforming solutions with your friends can provide? How about adding Sonic and friends? Sonic Pico Park features co-op for up to 8 players and bringing classic techniques like the Spin Dash into the mix. Will that be enough to fight off any resulting stress when the mistakes begin piling up? We’ll find out on November 12th.
As disappointed as the developer may have felt about it, Eidos Montreal’s single-player-focused adaptation of the Guardians of the Galaxy remains one of the best superhero games out there. Hence, the Encore Edition is coming to Nintendo Switch 2 on November 5th with new glam rock outfits. Players can expect a Quality mode with 1440p resolution targeting 30 FPS or Performance, which runs in 1080p and targets 40 FPS in docked mode, with Handheld mode only offering a 30 FPS target.
You just know that someone, somewhere, considers this their GTA 6, and honestly, good on them. You can also throw in couch or online co-op for up to four players, or a mix of both. Whether it holds up after all these years or not, this is a venerable blast from the past.

articles.t: Bagnolet : la fresque géante « GTA VI » a fini d’envahir les tours Mercuriales à 20 jours de la sortie du jeu vidéo
articles.chapeau: Aux portes de Paris, Jason et Lucia ont pris de la hauteur. Après plusieurs semaines de travaux, la fresque géante dédiée à « GTA VI » est désormais terminée sur les tours Mercuriales, à la porte de B...
articles.txt:
Aux portes de Paris, Jason et Lucia ont pris de la hauteur. Après plusieurs semaines de travaux, la fresque géante dédiée à « GTA VI » est désormais terminée sur les tours Mercuriales, à la porte de Bagnolet (Seine-Saint-Denis).
La jaquette du jeu recouvre l'une des deux tours, tandis que les deux protagonistes, Jason et Lucia, occupent chacun une autre face des deux bâtiments. Au total, six faces sont concernées.
Installée bande par bande par des cordistes depuis le début du mois d'octobre, la bâche est visible depuis le périphérique. Chacune des tours mesure 114 m, hors antenne.
Côté réglementation, le cabinet du maire de Bagnolet avait indiqué dans les médias que l'arrêté autorisant ces bâches « a été édicté au regard du règlement local de publicité intercommunal ».
Cette opération accompagne la sortie de « Grand Theft Auto VI », prévue le jeudi 19 novembre, dans vingt jours donc. Le dernier épisode de la saga, « GTA V », date de septembre 2013, soit plus de treize ans d'attente . Le titre de Rockstar Games sera disponible sur PlayStation 5 et Xbox Series X|S. Le plus célèbre des jeux vidéo vise le plus grand lancement de l'histoire après.
La troisième et dernière bande-annonce a été dévoilée le 15 octobre , à un mois de la sortie. Fin août, un aperçu étendu diffusé sur Netflix avait provoqué un afflux de connexions et des problèmes sur la plate-forme .

articles.t: Justice & Gesaffelstein s'unissent pour GTA VI - VOLTAGE
articles.chapeau: Justice dévoile « Pusher », sa toute première collaboration avec Gesaffelstein. Un titre instrumental et sombre, extrait de la bande originale de GTA VI composée par le duo, attendue le 11 décembre.
articles.txt:
Beaucoup l'attendaient, elle est désormais une réalité. Justice et Gesaffelstein signent avec « Pusher » leur premier morceau commun. D'un côté, Gaspard Augé et Xavier de Rosnay, figures de proue d'Ed Banger depuis le milieu des années 2000. De l'autre, le producteur lyonnais au visage masqué, maître d'une techno noire et industrielle, qui a collaboré avec Kanye West ou The Weeknd.
« Pusher » offre un nouvel aperçu de Grand Theft Auto VI: Original Score . Selon Rockstar Games, ce titre dévoile la facette instrumentale de la partition imaginée par Justice. Un virage nettement plus sombre que « Flower In a Hurricane », premier extrait réalisé avec Tame Impala , SZA et King Gizzard & The Lizard Wizard. Ce morceau a permis au duo de décrocher la 62e place du Billboard Hot 100, une première pour un titre porté par Justice en tête d'affiche.
Sélectionné par Rockstar, le duo a travaillé en étroite collaboration avec les équipes du studio. L'objectif : épouser au plus près l'univers du jeu et l'histoire de Jason et Lucia, ses deux héros. Résultat, la musique s'adapte en temps réel aux événements. Elle évolue selon votre manière d'explorer l'État fictif de Leonida et d'interagir avec ses habitants. Deux parties ne sonneront donc jamais tout à fait de la même façon.
Pour Xavier de Rosnay, l'immensité du jeu, sur le plan géographique comme thématique, imposait dès le départ une musique très variée en émotions, en genres et en textures. Le duo assure avoir bénéficié d'une liberté totale pour explorer toutes les pistes nécessaires. Une approche cohérente avec son parcours récent : après « Hyperdrama », album récompensé aux Grammy Awards, Justice continue d'élargir son terrain de jeu bien au-delà du dancefloor.
La bande originale sortira le 11 décembre en double CD et en triple vinyle. Deux versions seront proposées : une édition limitée transparente et une édition noire classique. Au programme, 30 titres, complétés par des bonus numériques qui forment une suite de trois heures tirée directement du jeu. Les précommandes sont déjà ouvertes. De quoi prolonger l'expérience GTA VI bien au-delà de la manette, et découvrir le son de Justice sous un jour inédit.

articles.txt:
A fresh round of GTA 6 storage reports landed on October 30, 2026, and the headline number is big. Gizbot, Ascendants, Times Now and XiaomiToday all ran the story that Grand Theft Auto VI may need a massive amount of space on PlayStation 5. The reported figure is 210 GB . Rockstar Games has not confirmed any install size for the game.
The number traces back to an account called PlayStation Game Size, and Insider Gaming reportedly corroborated it on its own. We covered the first wave in our earlier report on the 210 GB figure and what a physical edition may hold . This piece goes a step further. It sorts every size figure now in circulation, runs the download math, and lays out what players can do before the game ships.
The reports also cite a launch date of 19 November 2026. If that date holds, release is about 20 days away. The storage coverage does not independently confirm it, so we treat it as reported, not settled.

Most confusion around GTA 6 storage comes from mixing up figures that describe different things. One number describes a console install. Another describes a leaked development build. A third has been called fake by the reporting that mentions it. Keeping them apart is the first job.

The trail starts with PlayStation Game Size, an account that posts reported install sizes for PlayStation titles. According to the reports, that account put the PlayStation 5 size of Grand Theft Auto VI at 210 GB. Insider Gaming then reportedly landed on the same figure through its own sourcing.
Gizbot, Ascendants, Times Now and XiaomiToday picked the story up from there. Most of that wave is aggregation. When four outlets repeat one number, it looks like four confirmations, but it counts as roughly two original signals. The account and Insider Gaming are the load-bearing pieces.
That distinction matters for how much confidence to place in the result. An independent corroboration is better than a lone post, and it still falls short of a publisher statement. Store listings are the usual place where sizes become official, and nothing has appeared there yet in the reports we reviewed.
Leak-tracking accounts have mixed records, and a single correct call does not make the next one reliable. What helps here is that Insider Gaming, a separate outlet, reportedly arrived at the same figure. Two paths to one number is a better sign than one path repeated four times. It is still a sign, not a proof.

articles.t: GTA 6 pourrait sortir sur PC seulement 6 ou 7 mois après sa sortie sur consoles, selon un analyste
articles.chapeau: Annoncé sur consoles pour novembre 2026, GTA 6 laisse les joueurs PC dans l’incertitude. Entre fuites et analyse optimiste, la véritable fenêtre reste floue.
articles.txt:
Annoncé sur consoles pour novembre 2026, GTA 6 laisse les joueurs PC dans l’incertitude. Entre fuites et analyse optimiste, la véritable fenêtre reste floue.
GTA 6 a enfin une date de sortie sur consoles, mais les joueurs PC restent officiellement dans le flou. Rockstar Games a confirmé que Grand Theft Auto VI arrivera le 19 novembre 2026 sur PS5 et Xbox Series X|S , sans mention de version PC. De quoi réveiller le traumatisme GTA 5, arrivé presque deux ans plus tard sur ordinateur.
Cette fois, plusieurs signaux laissent pourtant penser que l’attente serait bien plus courte. Après une première fuite plaçant GTA 6 version PC au premier trimestre 2027, l’analyste Michael Pachter avance désormais une fenêtre de seulement six à sept mois après la sortie console. De quoi espérer, mais aussi se demander ce qui est réellement crédible.
Officiellement, la communication de Rockstar reste limpide et limitée : lancement le 19 novembre 2026, uniquement sur PS5 et Xbox Series X|S, aucune fiche PC sur Steam, Epic ou le launcher Rockstar. Pour l’instant, GTA 6 PC n’existe que dans les rumeurs.
Invité par la BBC, l’analyste de Wedbush Securities Michael Pachter a pourtant été très précis. Selon lui, « le jeu n’est pas exclusif à la PlayStation 5, il sort aussi sur les Xbox Series X|S, et dans environ 6 ou 7 mois il sortira sur PC. Beaucoup de gens vont pouvoir y accéder, mais l’explosion pour Sony en ce moment, c’est que les joueurs doivent avoir une console s’ils veulent y jouer au lancement ». En clair, il mise sur une sortie PC autour de mai ou juin 2027.
De son côté, un précédent rapport de GamesBeat parlait d’une date de sortie GTA 6 PC calée sur le premier trimestre 2027, soit entre janvier et mars, seulement deux à quatre mois après les consoles. Les deux scénarios restent non confirmés par Rockstar, mais convergent vers une arrivée sur PC en moins d’un an.
L’hypothèse d’un délai de six à sept mois colle mieux à l’historique de Rockstar Games. GTA IV avait mis environ sept mois à passer des consoles au PC, Red Dead Redemption 2 un an, et GTA 5 près de dix‑neuf mois. Même le scénario « pessimiste » de Pachter resterait donc plus généreux que les derniers gros portages du studio.
Chez la maison mère Take‑Two Interactive , Strauss Zelnick a rappelé que le PC représente désormais une part majeure du business, pouvant atteindre presque 50 % des ventes pour certains titres. La stratégie assumée reste de « commencer par la console », mais le poids économique du PC pousse logiquement à réduire l’écart.
Qu’il s’agisse du Q1 2027 de GamesBeat ou de la fenêtre mi‑2027 avancée par Pachter, tout pointe vers un GTA 6 portage PC plus rapide, potentiellement aussi pour limiter la montée de l’ émulation PS5 et du piratage. Tant que Rockstar se tait, ces éléments restent toutefois des estimations, pas un calendrier gravé dans le marbre.
Si vous refusez d’attendre, la seule option solide reste d’acheter ou de vous faire prêter une PS5 ou une Xbox Series X|S pour novembre 2026. C’est aujourd’hui le seul moyen garanti de jouer à Grand Theft Auto VI dès le jour J.
Si vous pouvez patienter entre six et douze mois, attendre GTA 6 sur PC a du sens : définition plus élevée, frame rate débloqué, mods, clavier‑souris, voire une version enrichie comme pour GTA 5 et Red Dead Redemption 2. Profitez de ce délai probable jusqu’en 2027 pour planifier un upgrade CPU ou GPU plutôt que de foncer sur une console.
Dans tous les cas, méfiance absolue envers les « clés GTA 6 PC », bêtas ou précommandes non validées par Rockstar. Tant que le studio n’a pas annoncé officiellement la version PC sur ses canaux, toute offre ressemble surtout à une arnaque. Reste à surveiller les prochains résultats financiers de Take‑Two et le site de Rockstar Games : c’est là que la vraie date tombera.

articles.t: Viral GTA 6 Watermark Leak Claim Debunked by Two Insiders | GTA BOOM
articles.chapeau: Insiders NateTheHate and Tom Henderson say Grand Theft Auto VI review copies are not watermarked, despite real security measures.
articles.txt:
A viral claim that Grand Theft Auto VI review copies carry flashing on-screen watermarks has been shot down by two reliable sources. The idea was that Rockstar Games , still stung by years of leaks, had gone to lengths such as stamping each review build with the reviewer's name so they could trace any leak back to its source.
The claim started on October 27, when content creator Jeremy, known as ManaByte on X, wrote that the leaks had spooked Rockstar into the said measure of watermarking review copies with the reviewer's name flashing on screen. It spread fast because it fit everything people expect from the most secretive studio in gaming.
Two days later, industry insider NateTheHate, generally regarded as a stronger source for Rockstar news, quoted the post and pushed back . "To my knowledge, this is not accurate," he wrote. "Review copies of Grand Theft Auto 6 are not watermarked." Tom Henderson of Insider Gaming came to the same conclusion , posting that "the watermark stuff isn't even true after a bit of digging. They have some insane security measures in place, though."
The claim was easy to believe because Rockstar has every reason to be paranoid. The studio is still dealing with the fallout of the 2022 breach that put early GTA 6 footage online , when a hacker pulled around 90 videos of pre-alpha gameplay from internal systems. The person behind it claimed to have taken source code that is reportedly still out there . A more recent leaker operating as CyberLeek even went as far as to dump advanced gameplay, cutscenes and explicit footage of the protagonists, which is why Take-Two Interactive went to court to unmask them .
What both insiders agree on is the security around GTA 6 review builds is real and severe, just not the flashing-name watermark ManaByte described. Rockstar is said to have started sending review copies to the lucky few , with the review embargo reportedly lifting on November 18, a day before launch. Whatever protections are on those builds , the studio has not described them publicly and has not commented on the watermark claim at all.
The watermark claim is the first piece of this timeline the bigger insiders have knocked down.
This is the newest twist in a leak saga that stretches back years. The 2022 intrusion set the tone. The CyberLeek dumps and the explicit footage that came with them raised the stakes while the hunt for the source continues. With review copies now in the wild and the first scores days away, every rumor about how Rockstar is guarding the game is going to travel, accurate or not. The watermark story is a reminder to check who is saying it before believing it.
Rockstar has not said a word about any of it and they probably never will until years down the line . The precautions are most likely real, and so is the paranoia, but the specifics will likely stay secret to the end .

articles.t: 'South Park' shows new 'GTA 6' gameplay footage
articles.chapeau: Don't get too excited, though. It really is a turd.
articles.txt:
Grand Theft Auto VI is said to take up more than 200GB of space on your PS5 or Xbox hard drive. Thanks to South Park , we now know where some of that data is going.
Matt Stone and Trey Parker's animated sitcom, which is somewhat amazingly still airing new episodes in 2026, took its ripped-from-the-headlines comedic stylings back into the gaming world on Wednesday night. In a scene from the newest episode, the kids learn about GTA 6 , which actually includes some new gameplay footage we haven't seen before, not even courtesy of Cyberleek .
Because it's South Park , though, the footage consists entirely of a dog pooping, the protagonist Jason picking up the poop, and Jason hitting an NPC in the face with it.
Yes, that is all they showed. As a bonus, it's narrated by Tish Hicks, a voice actress who narrated a gameplay trailer for GTA 5 many years ago, per IGN . According to IGN, Rockstar had previously confirmed that you could use dog poop in this way in GTA 6 , and we have seen Jason petting a dog in an earlier clip, but this is the first time we've actually seen this particular mechanic in action.
We reached out to Rockstar to confirm if the dog poop clip was legit, and we'll update this story if the company responds. However, the episode's credits include a Rockstar callout, which suggests the clip is authentic. A snapshot of the credits circulating online includes this message: "Special thanks: Grand Theft Auto VI footage courtesy of Rockstar Games, Inc."
This is far from the first or only time South Park has waded into the zeitgeist around a major video game. There have been plenty of references to gaming on the show over the years, perhaps most prominently in the 2006 episode Make Love, Not Warcraft , which took place largely inside World of Warcraft during the peak of that game's popularity. Maybe Parker and Stone can make a GTA 6 equivalent whenever that game's online mode launches.
In the meantime, you still have time to preorder GTA 6 ahead of its Nov. 19 release.

articles.chapeau: GTA 6 reviews will go live on November 18, a day before the game’s release. Media outlets and influencers have received codes, and Rockstar is being extra cautious about the possibility of leaks.
articles.txt:
Earlier this week, it was reported that GTA 6 review copies will have watermarks to identify those responsible in case of any leaks. Turns out that’s not true, but Rockstar still seems to have a solid plan in place to avoid leaks, or if that fails, to identify the leaker.
All the leaks for GTA 6 that Rockstar has failed to curtail have naturally made the studio extremely cautious. It was believed that they’re taking no chances with leaks coming from review copies, so they have watermarked the review copies with the reviewer’s name. Now, Insider Gaming’s Tom Henderson and credible leaker NateTheHate have stated that’s not true.
The latter shared on X that the watermark claim is not true, at least to their knowledge. Henderson also posted on X and stated that after a bit of digging, he found no evidence of this being true, but did state that Rockstar has “some insane security measures in place.” What these measures are exactly, remains unclear.
It’s not surprising for Rockstar to have gone the extra mile to make sure there are no more leaks as the review embargo lifts a day before the game’s release. Recent reports confirmed that media outlets and influencers have received review codes for GTA 6 and that the embargo is November 18. Plutôt que de publier un énième trailer, le studio s’est invité dans le dernier épisode de South Park avec une courte séquence de gameplay totalement inédite.
Et fidèle à l’humour de la série, cette apparition met en scène une fonctionnalité pour le moins insolite à savoir la possibilité de ramasser des excréments de chien pour s’en servir comme arme contre les PNJ.
Diffusé le 28 octobre 2026 sur Comedy Central, le quatrième épisode de la saison 29 de South Park , intitulé Guinea Pig on a Stick, réserve une surprise aux fans de Grand Theft Auto. Dans les dernières minutes, plusieurs personnages de la série, dont Cartman, Kyle et Stan, découvrent une vidéo de GTA 6.
La séquence débute par une promenade de Jason et Lucia sur une plage de Vice City, avant de montrer un chien en train de faire ses besoins sur le sable. Le joueur, qui contrôle Jason, provoque alors le propriétaire de l’animal en lui lançant un objet. Lorsque ce dernier réagit, Jason ramasse un sac contenant les excréments du chien et l’utilise pour frapper le PNJ.
New gameplay from GTA 6 was shown in the latest ‘SOUTH PARK’ episode. pic.twitter.com/gL2kRKUv2I
Une scène complètement ridicule, mais qui illustre une nouvelle fois l’importance accordée par Rockstar aux interactions avec les habitants de Leonida. Surtout, il ne s’agit pas d’une animation créée spécialement par South Park pour parodier le jeu. Rockstar Games apparaît dans les remerciements du générique, confirmant sa participation à cette séquence.
Cette apparition n’arrive pas totalement par hasard. Depuis le début de sa saison 29, South Park multiplie les références à GTA 6, dont la sortie est régulièrement présentée avec humour comme un événement susceptible de tout arranger.
Du gameplay, la map et les radios de GTA 6 ont fuité avant le large aperçu sur Netflix

La collaboration prend néanmoins une dimension supplémentaire avec ces véritables images du jeu, diffusées à quelques semaines seulement de son lancement.
Si cette mécanique liée aux excréments avait déjà été évoquée auparavant, c’est la première fois qu’elle est montrée aussi clairement en action. Cette séquence de 17 secondes rejoint ainsi les rares présentations officielles de gameplay, aux côtés du large aperçu diffusé sur Netflix et des différents trailers .

articles.t: South Park GTA 6 Clip: 17 Seconds Reported [2026]
articles.chapeau: South Park GTA 6 clip: what the dog poop beach scene shows, what is confirmed, and why the real-gameplay claim and 17-second length stay unproven.
articles.txt:
